run_nonrigidnerf_training: run the NeRF training loop on LLFF dataset with ray bending and autodecoder latents
create_nerf_model: create a NeRF MLP model with optional ray bender, fine network, and Adam optimizer
render_path_images: render RGB and disparity images along a sequence of camera poses with ray bending latents
render_rays_volumetric: perform volumetric rendering on a batch of rays using coarse and fine NeRF networks
parse_nerf_config: parse command line arguments for NeRF training including network depth, learning rate, and ray bending options
